open_text_result: No independent Menippus title corpus should be acquired from this entry. The direct source is Suda 613 (Μένιππος, κωμικός; Κέρκωπες and others), but Meineke 1839 p. 494 proposed correcting the name to Hermippus. Later discussion rejects that emendation as unproven because Cercopes is a non-distinctive comic title. Thus the evidence remains an uncertain Suda title testimony, already bounded in 1787.001.
